headline: $3B Blackwell server leak exposes US chip-control gap
body: A quiet day with one story. The New York Times reported a US subsidiary of blacklisted Inspur shipped about $3 billion of Nvidia Blackwell servers to Southeast Asia. Leaky export controls weaken Global Coordination, nudging Self-Destruction up and Gatekeeper down. Horizon Balance is -3.03.
movers_note: Gatekeeper -0.2, from the Blackwell export-control story (-0.14) and fading earlier news (-0.04). Self-Destruction +0.08, from the Blackwell export-control story (+0.10), partly offset by fading earlier news (-0.02).
